the use of text mining tools, and more precisely CA techniques, allows to identify and to extract the most useful words in a corpus of jurisprudence, and thus to improve the access to the corpus.

the combination of text mining techniques and CA is a powerful way to extract relevant information from textual databases, and that the results obtained can be used for various purposes, including the design of a more user friendly interface for the consultation of such databases.
